exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «Estoy muy cansada» → Marta dijo que ____ muy cansada.
exercises.explanation: Present becomes imperfect after a past reporting verb.
exercises.translation: “I'm very tired” → Marta said she was very tired.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «Mañana iré al médico» → Dijo que ____ al médico al día siguiente.
exercises.explanation: Future becomes conditional; mañana becomes al día siguiente.
exercises.translation: “Tomorrow I'll go to the doctor” → He said he would go to the doctor the next day.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «Ya he terminado el informe» → Me explicó que ya ____ el informe.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect becomes pluperfect: había + participle.
exercises.translation: “I've already finished the report” → She explained that she had already finished the report.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «Ven a mi casa» → Me dijo que ____ a su casa.
exercises.explanation: A command becomes the imperfect subjunctive after a past reporting verb.
exercises.translation: “Come to my house” → He told me to come to his house.

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «¿Dónde vives?» → Me preguntó dónde ____.
exercises.explanation: In reported questions the question word stays and the verb shifts back.
exercises.translation: “Where do you live?” → She asked me where I lived.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor está en pasado).
exercises.text: «Compré el billete ayer» → Dijo que ____ el billete el día anterior.
exercises.explanation: The preterite becomes pluperfect; ayer becomes el día anterior.
exercises.translation: “I bought the ticket yesterday” → He said he had bought the ticket the day before.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige la forma correcta.
exercises.text: «Tengo hambre» → Luis dijo que ____ hambre.
exercises.explanation: Present becomes imperfect indicative; the subjunctive is only for commands and wishes.
exercises.translation: “I'm hungry” → Luis said he was hungry.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige la forma correcta.
exercises.text: «Llegaré tarde» → Pedro dijo que ____ tarde.
exercises.explanation: Future becomes conditional after a past reporting verb.
exercises.translation: “I'll be late” → Pedro said he would be late.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige la palabra correcta.
exercises.text: «¿Has visto mi móvil?» → Me preguntó ____ había visto su móvil.
exercises.explanation: Yes/no questions are reported with si, not que.
exercises.translation: “Have you seen my phone?” → He asked me if I had seen his phone.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige la forma correcta.
exercises.text: «Cierra la puerta» → Ana me dijo que ____ la puerta.
exercises.explanation: A command after a past reporting verb takes the imperfect subjunctive.
exercises.translation: “Close the door” → Ana told me to close the door.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige la forma correcta.
exercises.text: «Te llamaré mañana» → Me prometió que me ____ al día siguiente.
exercises.explanation: Future becomes conditional; the time marker changes to al día siguiente.
exercises.translation: “I'll call you tomorrow” → She promised she would call me the next day.
exercises.attribution: Generated by Claude; review before trusting

exercises.prompt: Elige el marcador correcto.
exercises.text: «Hoy no trabajo» → Dijo que ____ no trabajaba.
exercises.explanation: Hoy becomes ese día in reported speech about another moment.
exercises.translation: “Today I'm not working” → He said he wasn't working that day.

exercises.prompt: Pasa a estilo indirecto (el verbo introductor va en pasado).
exercises.text: Mi madre me dice: «Come más verdura».

exercises.translation: My mother told me to eat more vegetables.

exercises.translation: Pablo asked if I wanted a coffee.

exercises.prompt: Corrige el error de la frase.
exercises.text: Me dijo que cerrar la puerta.

exercises.explanation: After que, a reported command needs the imperfect subjunctive, not the infinitive.
exercises.translation: He told me to close the door.
